text:
Carmen: Noticed on narrow phones the right rail opening pushes the runs table into a horizontal scroll and action buttons get hidden. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/resp-01
Dev: Repro on iPhone SE and Pixel 7a. Table uses min-width per column so it overflows instead of collapsing. Also seeing odd duplicate header when orientation changes.
Sofia: Two things: (1) set clear breakpoints: <380px -> compact cards, 380-420px -> condensed table, >420px -> full table. (2) avoid 100vh for height math, it causes fold/keyboard jumps. Use visualViewport or --vh pattern.
Keenan: For the sidebar animation: using transform: translateX keeps the main layout width; switching to position:fixed + width toggle makes the layout recalc but can be janky. Alternative: keep transform but dispatch a resize at animation end: requestAnimationFrame(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'))).
Carmen: Product wants an always-reachable actions affordance. Proposal: condensed table gets a sticky actions column (narrow) with a menu; compact cards include a caret menu. That keeps CTAs accessible without horizontal scroll.
Sofia: Accessibility: when sidebar opens trap focus, set aria-modal="true" on the rail and aria-hidden="true" on the background. Add a skip-to-results link visible to keyboard users. Also ensure status pills meet 4.5:1 contrast and touch targets >=44px.
a11y-bot: Recommend aria-live polite for counts when filters change and announce "Showing X runs". Ensure menu buttons have aria-expanded and keyboard operable.
Dev: For visual polish: when condensed table might overflow, show a subtle right-edge gradient indicating horizontal content. Use ellipsis in compact rows only, cards show full labels.
Keenan: I'll prototype: --vh update on resize/visualViewport, sticky actions column, and focus-trap util for the sidebar. Will include before/after screenshots and an a11y checklist in the PR.
Carmen: Copy tweak: change empty state from "No runs" to "No runs match your filters" with hint line: "Try clearing filters or widening the date range." Add aria-live update when filters change the count.
Dev: QA checklist: iPhone SE, Pixel 7a, Pixel Fold portrait/landscape, VoiceOver, TalkBack, keyboard navigation. Add visual diff for compact cards.
pipeline-bot: queued canary job "mobile-sidebar-compact-cards" for branch fix/mobile-compact-actions.
Carmen: Moving this to P2 for the sprint. Tagging design for review tomorrow morning. :eyes:
